Per-token-row weighting by float mask (1.0/0.0 — explicit cast to avoid int/long mishaps per Notes #3). sum[j] / sum(mask). Zero-guard denom (empty text → return new float[384] = zeros). src_McpMemoryService_Services_OnnxEmbedd.NAME: L2Normalize
src_McpMemoryService_Services_OnnxEmbedd.annotation: private static void L2Normalize(float[] vector). double accum norm = sqrt(sum v[i]^2). If norm > 1e-12 → v[i] = (float)(v[i]/norm) in-place; else leave zeros. Edge: zero vector (empty text) stays zero — EmbedAsync_EmptyText_ReturnsValidVector only asserts length, not norm.
